# People and cooperations

The project **WetFlorVegChange** was conceived by a team of Central European scientists, based primarily at Masaryk University ([Core team](https://wetflorvegchange.github.io/People/core_team.html)), but the project would not be possible without the collaboration of numerous European experts ([Data contributors](https://wetflorvegchange.github.io/People/data_contributors.html)).
